title: JSON Interface V2.5
Description: JSON Interface: between what a person says, as text, and an application that is driven by JSON instances. It is the same for every application: the application is given to it as the schema of its commands and the schema of its responses (CommandSchemaURI and ResponseSchemaURI, in the DataXMData of its L3). Request to command: a request in words, with what the AIM remembers of the commands it sent, becomes an Application JSON Instance (MMC-AJI) that conforms to the command schema, checked against it before it leaves; a request that is not for the application, or that does not become a valid instance, gives no command and a Facts text saying why. Response to facts: a response of the application, an Application JSON Instance that conforms to the response schema and names the command it answers (InReplyTo), becomes a Text Object of facts, from the descriptions in the schema: what was done, what was not, and why. The AIM does not decide what is said to the person: the facts go to the dialogue AIM.
